steps: Safely materialize all six pinned archives in owned workspace; four submodules are separate source assets, not supplied inside the recipe tar.

Pin x64 MSVC v143 and Windows SDK plus CPython 3.13 development headers/import library, setuptools/wheel build tooling. Record exact versions/hashes/tool acquisition paths; do not conflate PBS runtime alone with a complete build toolchain.

Build libiconv static Release x64, then zlib zlib_a.lib, libxml2 libxmla, libxslt libxslta/libexslta using official source projects. Wrap every exit code; derive output paths instead of hardcoded directories. Record compiler/linker inputs and actual library hashes.
Stage local headers and libraries with names expected by lxml: iconv_a, libxml2_a, libxslt_a, libexslt_a, zlib; resolve from actual project outputs, don't fabricate missing libraries.

Disable STATICBUILD/STATIC_DEPS. Feed local INCLUDE and LIBRARY lists and static macros LIBXML_STATIC/LIBXSLT_STATIC/LIBEXSLT_STATIC. Proposed setup.py bdist_wheel --static --without-cython consumes existing generated C; do not use --static-deps or permit source-download fallback.

Retain full source archives, Windows projects, all patches/changes, applied source mapping, generated C and Python/Cython sources, notices, exact toolchain/command logs, linker maps, fresh derived wheel/member hashes.

In a separate disposable build, modify libiconv compatibly with a traceable harmless marker, rebuild it and dependent link outputs; ensure both etree/objectify rebuilt as appropriate and exercise encoding conversion, XPath/XSLT, Chinese-path import offline.
